source_title: Pixel 10 Pro XL owners can grab Google’s PixelSnap case for 58% off
source_excerpt:

Google’s PixelSnap Phone Case for the Pixel 10 Pro XL is the official case for the phone and is built around Google’s own magnetic accessory system. There’s also a strong deal on it right now, which makes this a good time to pick one up on Amazon.
This case is designed specifically for the Pixel 10 Pro XL, so the main draw is the fit and the built-in PixelSnap magnetic support. That means it works with magnetic chargers, stands, grips, wallets, and similar add-ons. It’s also aimed at people who want the official Google look rather than a thick, rugged shell. The case appears to use a soft-touch outer finish with a microfiber inner lining, and it keeps a slim profile while adding everyday scratch and drop protection. Wireless charging convenience is part of the package too, so you don’t have to give that up just to keep your phone covered.
Google also offers the case in multiple color options, including darker choices like Obsidian and lighter ones such as Moonstone, though stock can vary by seller. Overall, it’s a light, slim case that focuses on style, fit, and PixelSnap support.
As for the deal, Amazon has the Google PixelSnap Phone Case for the Pixel 10 Pro XL down to $20.99. That’s a $29 discount from the $49.99 recommended retail price, which works out to 58% off RRP. It’s also the lowest price we’ve seen in at least six months, so this looks like a strong chance to grab the official Google case for a lot less than usual.
